item.title: Community to feel impact of NAS Lemoore canceling 2026 air show
item.description: It's an event thousands of locals were looking forward to but because of the war in Iran, Naval Air Station Lemoore decided to cancel this year's air show.

item.title: Accuweather Forecast
item.description: Watch the latest Accuweather forecast on ABC30 Action News.

item.title: 68-year-old man hit and killed by car in central Fresno identified
item.description: The man who was hit and killed by a car in central Fresno has been identified as 68-year-old Donald Burkes.

item.title: Computerized scan of heart can help prevent potential problems
item.description: One in five deaths in the U.S. is due to heart disease, according to federal health experts. A computerized scan of the heart can prevent potential problems and symptoms from getting worse.

item.title: Texas judge declines to close Camp Mystic despite family's request after last year's floods
item.description: Judge Maya Guerra Gamble did order Camp Mystic's owners not to alter or demolish the cabins where campers were housed during the floods.

item.title: 'Hoppers,' Disney-Pixar's latest animated adventure, features beavers as animal superheroes
item.description: Beavers are the superstars of "Hoppers." The filmmakers regard them as the animal superheroes of the environment. They worked with scientists to learn all about beavers as they created a story about the importance of community.

item.title: Central Valley allergy season arrives early as temperatures rise
item.description: Warmer temperatures across the Central Valley are drawing people outside, but those with seasonal allergies may be feeling a sneeze coming on.

item.title: Tacos El Cabezon owner prepares to open first location in downtown Fresno
item.description: A Fresno taco truck that has found rapid success is set to open its first brick-and-mortar spot in downtown Fresno next week.

item.title: Small plane hits homes in Phoenix, crashes nose-down next to backyard pool, injuring 3
item.description: A small plane struck two homes in Phoenix on Wednesday before crashing nose-down in a backyard, injuring the two people on board and a man in one of the homes, authorities said.

item.title: Judge rules companies entitled to refunds for Trump tariffs overturned by SCOTUS
item.description: In a defeat for the Trump administration, a federal judge in New York ruled Wednesday that companies that paid tariffs struck down last month by Supreme Court are due refunds.
